26.old: Townhomes are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
26.new: Under the BC Strata Property Act, townhomes are held as strata title. Before you remove subjects, get Form B, the depreciation report, the rental, pet and age-restriction bylaws and the strata minutes for the past two years. In 55+ and 45+ complexes, at least one occupant has to meet the age bylaws.

28.old: Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
28.new: Floodplain: the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain takes in parts of Yarrow, Rosedale, Greendale, Fairfield Island and lower Sardis, and the City's dike network protects it. Ask what the flood construction level is for the property, what lenders and insurers require, and whether title shows a registered geotechnical or floodplain covenant.

30.old: Schools and transit: Chilliwack is served by School District 33 (SD33) — Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit runs Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express (Route 66) links Chilliwack to Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.
30.new: Schools and transit: Chilliwack's schools come under School District 33 (SD33), whose schools include G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Sardis Secondary and Chilliwack Secondary, along with many elementary catchments (Unsworth, Watson and Vedder among them). Confirm the catchment with SD33 before buying.
